title: Songify - Django & Spotify API
description:
A refactor of the project I worked on during the first year of my studies.

I used it as a way to play around with Django. It uses the Spotify API to fetch categories and statistics with the most popular songs of chosen artists.

Since then, I’ve extended it with:
- User authentication using Spotify
- Song recommendations based on user listening history
- Redis for caching to improve user experience
- Dockerized setup with separate production and development environments
- Celery integration (now deprecated) for background task automation

The project is complete for now, but may receive updates in the future.

title: Web Dashboard - DP
description:
A dashboard with a very similar site layout & tools I've used at ASML, but with my own idea.

Of course, the ASML web-dashboard solution was way more rich in features & personalization.

The idea behind such dashboard is to enable overview of historical training data, as well as growth metrics over extended period of time, which aids in making long-term training based decisions.

Current version of this dashboard is just a concept with fake data.

title: Mobile App - DP
description:
A mobile interface used for:
- Fetching list of workout plans
- Loading exercises per workout
- Taking in workout session data and updating database records

Conceptually this mobile 'app' should not go beyond loading workout sessions and taking in session data - so it can be later used to make long-term decisions

Currently it is still an idea, eventually will be realized and shared here

title: API - DP
description:
API that will be used to serve formatted data to the dashboard and handle workout data - which will be collected from a mobile interface.

As with 'Mobile App - DP', this is still an idea and will be worked on in parallel with other compoenents of the DP project.
